CustomField.description: The AI Workflow Action the model suggested in this reply, if any - parsed out of a trailing structured block in the model's response. Never executed automatically; the chat UI reads this to offer a button, and the action only runs when the user explicitly confirms it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set only when the model's reply suggests running a Workflow Action. The action still requires explicit user confirmation to run.
CustomField.label: Suggested Workflow Action
